claims.claim: 分析依據截至2025年12月31日、於2026年2月18日提交的10-K
claims.note: list_sections: period_of_report 2025-12-31, filing_date 2026-02-18

claims.claim: 淨零情境建立在政策、技術等大量假設之上，具有重大不確定性
claims.note: Item 1A: net-zero derive from hypothetical scenarios ... reflect substantial uncertainties

claims.claim: 引用第三方情境不代表公司認為該情境最可能發生，投資決策以自身規劃流程為依據
claims.note: Item 7: reference to any scenario does not imply likely; third-party use not endorsement; investment decisions on separate planning process

claims.claim: 公司透過多種情境和轉型信號（signposts）調整投資方向
claims.note: Item 7: monitor a variety of signposts; uses many scenarios to identify signposts

claims.claim: 政策風險包括碳稅、碳交易、碳邊境措施、排放效率標準、電動車銷售強制要求、限制油氣許可與基礎設施、對油氣融資施壓、要求提交減排計畫
claims.note: Item 1A Greenhouse gas restrictions: cap and trade, carbon taxes, carbon-based import duties, efficiency standards, EV mandates, delaying infrastructure, reducing financing, disclosure of plans

claims.claim: 這些政策可能降低投資回報、提高產品成本、延長項目週期、減少碳氫化合物需求、令產品相對低碳替代品失去競爭力
claims.note: Item 1A: could negatively affect investment returns, make products more expensive or less competitive, lengthen project implementation times, reduce demand

claims.claim: 若政策限制油氣供應但需求未同步下降，可能造成能源短缺、價格波動和通脹壓力
claims.note: Item 1A: restricting availability without commensurate reduction in demand -> price volatility, inflationary pressures, energy shortages

claims.claim: 新業務包括CCS、氫和氨、低排放燃料、碳材料、低碳數據中心、鋰
claims.note: Item 1/Item 7 business description lists these

claims.claim: 低碳業務的增長和未來回報取決於支持性政策和市場能否形成
claims.note: Item 1A: growth and future returns of LCS ... depend on stable and supportive government policies and markets

claims.claim: 若投資者認為公司轉型進展不足可能損害聲譽，追求轉型把資本投入低回報項目也可能受批評
claims.note: Item 1A Reputation paragraph: insufficient progress ... or allocation of capital to investments with reduced returns

claims.claim: 公司表示保留投資靈活性，以最大化股東價值
claims.note: Item 7: we retain investment flexibility to maximize shareholder value

claims.claim: 低碳投資實際規模取決於可投資機會、公共政策支持，並以回報為重點
claims.note: Item 7: actual investment levels subject to opportunity set, public policy support, and focused on returns

claims.claim: 上游投資集中在低供應成本項目，強調圭亞那、二疊紀盆地和LNG
claims.note: Item 7: Upstream capital program focused on low cost-of-supply; Guyana, Permian, LNG

claims.claim: 2025年上游產量平均每天470萬桶油當量，為逾40年來最高
claims.note: Item 7: 4.7 Moebd, highest production in over 40 years

claims.claim: 約三分之二全球產量來自二疊紀、圭亞那和LNG，預計比例仍會提高
claims.note: Item 7: about two thirds ... This proportion is generally expected to grow
